name: Malygos
guide_text: If you triple into or buy a battlecry card, you can play it to get its battlecry effect and then transform it again to a good tempo unit.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up on turn 6 and try to line up 6 drops using your hero power. Then, play into them.
